text: Machine learning is a type of artificial intelligence that allows computers to learn from data without being explicitly programmed. In supervised learning, the most common approach, a computer is given training data — examples that already include the correct answers. The system uses this data to build a model, which is like a set of rules it has discovered. Once the model is ready, it can make predictions about new, unseen information. For example, it might predict whether an email is spam or not. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy, which shows how often the model is correct.
